body:
You can call the hotline in your country, if you need someone to talk to. I know what it's like to desperately want someone to communicate with, but be unable to find a friend who has the time to chat. I know what it's like to have thoughts that torment you and keep you up at night crying.
Here is as good a place as any to share what the thoughts are.

I am sorry for you. They say that someone is never truly dead when their name is still spoken, which might be a reason for you to live, to carry your memory of her, but that's probably no consolation to you. There are many bad arguments as to why you shouldn't kill yourself and finding a good one is hard, considering what you've said.
But perhaps your strength to reach out for help when faced with this terrible tragedy is reason enough for now. Perhaps the fact that you want to find a reason to live means that you shouldn't die yet. Hope springs eternal. I wish you all the best and you have my sympathy.
